title: The Crystal Cave
description: An integration and wholeness arc. Deep beneath the mountains, every crystal holds a memory — joy and sorrow, strength and weakness. The traveler learns that wholeness includes the broken pieces.

acts.title: The Descent
acts.description: The traveler enters a cave where crystals glow with captured emotions — some radiant, some dark. Each one is a part they exiled.

acts.title: The Gathering
acts.description: The traveler collects crystals one by one. Each one burns when touched — the cost of reclaiming what was sent away.

acts.title: The Constellation
acts.description: Arranged together, the crystals form a pattern — not a flaw map, but a constellation. The traveler is the sum of every piece.
